items.informal_name: Non-torsion Weight Criterion for Functions with Non-zero Values in Torsion-Free Modules over Domains
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_3) [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] [IsDomain R] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M], (∀ (i : σ), w i ≠ 0) → Finsupp.NonTorsionWeight R w
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a domain, $ M $ a torsion-free $ R $-module, and $ w : \sigma \to M $ a function such that $ w(i) \neq 0 $ for all $ i : \sigma $. Then $ w $ satisfies the non-torsion weight condition, i.e., there is no non-zero $ r \in R $ such that $ r \cdot w(i) = 0 $ in $ M $ for all $ i : \sigma $.

items.informal_name: Weighted sum of vectors indexed by σ over R
items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    {R : Type u_3} → [inst : Semiring R] → (σ → M) → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [Module R M] → (σ →₀ R) →+ M
items.informal_description: The additive homomorphism from the space of finite support functions $ \sigma \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which maps each finite support function $ d $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Evaluation: $ \text{weight } w f = \sum_{i \in \text{support } f} c_i \cdot w(i) $
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 R $, the weight function applied to $ f $ is equal to the sum over all $ i $ in the support of $ f $ of $ c \cdot w(i) $, where $ c $ is the coefficient of $ i $ in $ f $ and $ w : \sigma \to M $ is a function assigning vectors to indices.

items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Inequality for Finite Support Functions
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (w : σ → ℕ) {s : σ}, w s ≠ 0 → ∀ (f : σ →₀ ℕ), f s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f
items.informal_description: For any function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, element $ s \in \sigma $ with $ w(s) \neq 0 $, and finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, the value $ f(s) $ is less than or equal to the weighted sum $ \sum_{t \in \text{support } f} w(t) \cdot f(t) $.

items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} → (R : Type u_3) → [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [Module R M] → (σ → M) → Prop
items.informal_description: A proposition asserting that a function $ f : \sigma \to M $ does not have torsion under scalar multiplication by a semiring $ R $, i.e., there is no non-zero $ r \in R $ such that $ r \cdot f(\sigma) $ is trivial in the module $ M $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Zero iff Function Zero
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M]
  [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] (w : σ → M) [Finsupp.NonTorsionWeight ℕ w] {f : σ →₀ ℕ}, (Finsupp.weight w) f = 0 ↔ f = 0

items.informal_name: Weighted total degree of a multivariate polynomial
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring R] →
      {σ : Type u_3} → [AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : SemilatticeSup M] → [OrderBot M] → (σ → M) → MvPolynomial σ R → M
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and a weighting function $ w : \sigma \to M $ where $ M $ is a sup-semilattice, this function computes the supremum of the weights $ w(s) $ over all monomials $ s $ in the support of $ p $. The weight $ w(s) $ of a monomial $ s $ is defined as the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } s} s(i) \cdot v_i $ for some fixed vectors $ v_i $ associated with indices $ i $. The result is an element of $ M $ representing the weighted total degree of $ p $.

items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → {σ : Type u_3} → [AddCommMonoid M] → (σ → M) → MvPolynomial σ R → M → Prop
items.informal_description: A multivariate polynomial $\varphi$ is weighted homogeneous of weight $m$ with respect to the weight function $w : \sigma \to M$ if every monomial $d$ with nonzero coefficient in $\varphi$ satisfies $\sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot w(i) = m$, where $d(i)$ denotes the exponent of variable $i$ in the monomial.

items.informal_name: Weighted homogeneous component of a multivariate polynomial
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring R] → {σ : Type u_3} → [AddCommMonoid M] → (σ → M) → M → MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $, a weight function $ w : \sigma \to M $, and a value $ n \in M $, this is the linear map that sends each polynomial to its weighted homogeneous component of degree $ n $. This component consists of all terms whose weighted degree (computed using $ w $) equals $ n $, forming a submodule of $ R[\sigma] $.

items.informal_name: Weighted total degree of a multivariate polynomial
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring R] →
      {σ : Type u_3} → [AddCommMonoid M] → [SemilatticeSup M] → (σ → M) → MvPolynomial σ R → WithBot M
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to M $, the weighted total degree of $ p $ is defined as the supremum of the weights of its monomials. Each monomial's weight is computed by summing the product of its exponent on each variable and the corresponding weight assigned by $ w $. The result is an element of $ \text{WithBot} \, M $, where $ \bot $ represents the case when $ p $ is the zero polynomial.

items.informal_description: If $ M $ is an additive torsion-free monoid and the weight function $ w : \sigma \to M $ satisfies $ w(i) \neq 0 $ for all $ i \in \sigma $, then $ w $ is a non-torsion weight.

items.informal_description: For a non-zero multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $, with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to M $ where $ M $ is a sup-semilattice, the weighted total degree $ \text{weightedTotalDegree}'(w, p) $ (taking values in $ \text{WithBot} \, M $) equals the canonical embedding $ \uparrow $ of the weighted total degree $ \text{weightedTotalDegree}(w, p) $ (taking values in $ M $) into $ \text{WithBot} \, M $. items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {w : σ → M} (n : M)
  (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) [inst_2 : DecidableEq M] (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff d ((MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n) φ) =
    if (Finsupp.weight w) d = n then MvPolynomial.coeff d φ else 0

items.informal_name: Linear Map Applied to Linear Combination Distributes Over the Combination
items.informal_description: For any linear map $ f : M \to M' $ between $ R $-modules and any finite support function $ l : M \to_0 R $, applying $ f $ to the linear combination $ \sum_{m \in \text{support } l} l(m) \cdot m $ yields the linear combination $ \sum_{m \in \text{support } l} l(m) \cdot f(m) $. In symbols: $ f\left(\sum_{m} l(m) \cdot m\right) = \sum_{m} l(m) \cdot f(m) $.

items.informal_name: Linear Combination of Vectors Indexed by α over R
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {M' : Type u_8} [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (v : α → M) (l : α →₀ R),
  f ((Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l) = (Finsupp.linearCombination R (⇑f ∘ v)) l
items.informal_description: The linear map from the space of finite support functions $ \alpha \to_0 R $ to the $ R $-module $ M $, which sends each finite support function $ l $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } l} l(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $.

items.informal_description: For any linear map $ f : M \to N $ over a semiring $ R $, index type $ \iota $, function $ g : \iota \to M $, and finite support function $ l : \iota \to_0 R $, it holds that $ f\left( \sum_{i \in \text{support } l} l(i) \cdot g(i) \right) = \sum_{i \in \text{support } l} l(i) \cdot f(g(i)) $.

items.type:

      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → (α → M) → (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M
items.informal_description: The linear map from the space of finite support functions $ \alpha \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which sends each finite support function $ d $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $. This map is constructed using the linear equivalence of summing scalar multiples of individual vectors embedded via the right scalar multiplication operation.

items.informal_name: Composition with Linear Map Preserves Linear Combinations
items.type:

  {M' : Type u_8} [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] {v : α → M} (f : M →ₗ[R] M'),
